verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents several narrow bulk-style features. Bulk edit lets you add or modify many request parameters at once. Headers and auth set on a collection apply to all requests in it. Collections and environments can be imported simultaneously, and the CLI runs whole collections. None of these is a general mechanism for selecting many items and acting on them in one operation. Missing for 10: bulk edit/delete/move across many requests or collections, bulk operations exposed for agents via CLI or MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.
